quarterly_data.quarter: Zealand Pharma press release: Zealand Pharma announces positive Phase 2 ZUPREME-2 topline (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Positive Phase 2 ZUPREME-2 topline: petrelintide achieved up to 9.2% mean body-weight reduction at week 28 versus 2.0% with placebo in 220 people with overweight or obesity and type 2 diabetes, HbA1c reduction of up to 0.65% versus an increase of 0.23% on placebo, and GI-related discontinuation of 1.9% versus 1.7%; full results to be presented at an upcoming scientific conference.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 9.2% weight loss vs 2.0% placebo (week 28)
